telemetry_name: Audi R8 LMS GT3 Evo II
confidence_notes: Second simulator entry for a car curated from AMS2. Clutch-free move-off, six gears, clutchless upshifts at sustained full throttle, clutchless downshifts on a closed throttle with an automatic blip, and a GT rim with no display and no shift lights were directly observed. The upshift needing no lift and the downshift needing no blip were established by the drive's two-stage test rather than assumed, and both agree with the AMS2 values. The automatic cut is not established and cannot be by this method: Assetto Corsa EVO publishes no engine torque to SimHub and the cut is ignition-side. AMS2 established it independently and that value is unchanged.
scope_notes: Single exact identity staged from one guided-verification drive.
